name: catenary stage
definition_zh: 大变形条件下主要由钢筋拉力提供抗倒塌作用的结构受力阶段。
usage_note: 本文简化模型适用于低层RC框架，对多层结构Vierendeel作用另有限制。

complete_examples.text: Finally, the collapse resistance of tensile catenary stage is calculated by Eq. (42).
This is mainly because the tensile force, under catenary stage, was provided by the reinforcement of the whole RC frame structure.
